About

Building the parts, not just modeling them.

I'm a final-year Mechanical Engineering student working across CAD, CNC manufacturing, and embedded robotics. I've taken two prototypes end-to-end — an IoT-enabled filament extrusion system and an ESP32-based regenerative braking system — applying DFM and GD&T thinking from first sketch to machined part.

As Vice Chair of the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society student chapter, I co-organize industrial robotics workshops and technical events, coordinating with faculty and industry professionals along the way.

Right now I'm looking for an internship — robotics, automation, or manufacturing — where I can bring that same build-fast, iterate-faster approach to a real production floor.

Sheet 04 / 06 — Projects
Featured Projects

Two prototypes, shipped end to end

IoT-Based Automated 3D Printer Filament Extrusion System Using Solid Waste

PRJ.01
  • Engineered an automated plastic-to-filament recycling system, designing the IoT-enabled extrusion pipeline in SolidWorks and integrating ESP32-based automated process control to cut raw material and manufacturing cost.
  • Implemented real-time control logic across extrusion, cooling, and spooling stages using Arduino/ESP32 and CNC-machined components, reducing manual monitoring and material waste.
  • Applied DFM principles and GD&T tolerancing while maintaining an accurate BOM across design iterations — cutting fixture lead time as measured by fewer rework cycles against a manual extrusion baseline.
Tools — Fusion 360 · SolidWorks · Arduino / ESP32 · CNC Machining · 3D Printing

Adaptive Regenerative Braking System

PRJ.02
  • Developed a gradient-adaptive regenerative braking system for EV applications using an ESP32 microcontroller and ADXL335 accelerometer to dynamically adjust braking intensity via PWM-controlled BLDC motor output.
  • Built sensor-to-actuator control logic in Embedded C and validated performance through iterative testing, increasing real-time vehicle stability during incline/decline braking.
  • Resolved intermittent braking lag by running root-cause analysis on sensor calibration error and recalibrating the accelerometer input pipeline — improving braking efficiency and energy recovery against a fixed-braking baseline.
Tools — ESP32 · ADXL335 Accelerometer · BLDC Motor · PWM Control · Embedded C · Arduino IDE
